title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: when the records allow a replenishment transfer amount to be worked out
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks for a monthly automatic transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from the savings account in a statement cycle, together with the withdrawal fee amount the account bears for that cycle. It lists the conditions, read from the records, under which the monthly amount is worked out at all.

## Policy clause

The monthly amount is worked out only when all of the following hold. Each is read from the records, and each is a condition for applying the policy that the amount worked out does not itself test.

1. **Current cycle.** The cycle found from the most recent overdraft protection transfer is the current statement cycle, the cycle that closes on the next statement cycle closing date, as the current date and the account's statement cycle day show.
2. **Nothing posting later.** No transaction on the account has a posted date later than the current date, as the ledger shows, so that every refund and fee the amount must reflect has posted. A refund or fee made on a Saturday, Sunday or Federal Reserve holiday posts on the next business day.
3. **Refunds of the same cycle.** Every excess withdrawal fee refund posted in the cycle refunds a fee of that same cycle, as the fee each refund names shows.

When any of them fails, no amount is worked out under this policy.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- **Last overdraft transfer in an earlier cycle.** The most recent overdraft protection transfer posted in the statement cycle before the current one. The cycle found is not the current cycle, so no amount is worked out under this policy.
- **Holiday contact.** On a Federal Reserve holiday a fee refund is made in the contact; it will post on the next business day, later than the current date. No amount is worked out under this policy until it has posted.
- **Refund of an older fee.** A refund posted in the cycle refunds an excess withdrawal fee of the previous cycle. Condition 3 fails, so no amount is worked out under this policy.

## Points of judgement

**Is it enough that the cycle contains an overdraft protection transfer?** No; all three conditions must hold as well.
